configurePresets.name: native
configurePresets.displayName: Native x86 (SDL2 + desktop GL/GLES2/Software, OpenAL audio)
configurePresets.description: 32-bit native build (needs a 32-bit SDL2; openal-soft is fetched, built and copied beside the binary as libopenal.so.1). The web's renderers plus desktop GL (NOpenGLDrv), and OpenAL audio. BUILD_STATIC links every package into one Unreal.bin: no Core.so/Engine.so beside it, and appGetDllHandle resolves through the internal UNREAL_STATIC registry instead of dlopen (SDL2, libGL and libopenal.so.1 stay dynamic). Builds in build-native/.

configurePresets.name: native64
configurePresets.description: 64-bit (LP64) native build: the same one-binary package set as `native`, compiled for x86_64 instead of -m32 (needs the amd64 libsdl2-dev). Retail 32-bit .u packages run unchanged. Builds in build-native64/.

configurePresets.name: wasm
configurePresets.description: Emscripten web build: -O2 + DWARF + assertions. The everyday dev build — named stacks and readable errors while the engine still runs at a playable speed. Builds in build-wasm/. Run `source <emsdk>/emsdk_env.sh` first (sets EMSDK).

configurePresets.name: wasm-debug
configurePresets.description: Emscripten web build: -O0, nothing inlined, every local live. Reach for it when the optimiser is the suspect — a bug that shows at one -O level and not another is almost always undefined behaviour. Builds in build-wasm-debug/.

configurePresets.name: wasm-perf
configurePresets.description: Emscripten shipping build: -O2 compile, -O3 link, no debug info, no assertions. Builds in build-wasm-perf/.

configurePresets.name: windows
configurePresets.description: 32-bit Windows build. Cross-compiles from Linux via the toolchain file (i686-w64-mingw32 + a fetched SDL2); the same preset works from an MSYS2 MINGW32 prompt, where pacman's SDL2 answers instead. BUILD_STATIC links every package into the exe — no Core.dll/Engine.dll, and appGetDllHandle resolves through the internal registry, not LoadLibrary. Renderers are NOpenGL (desktop GL via opengl32) + NOpenGLES (GLES2 — needs ANGLE's libEGL.dll/libGLESv2.dll beside the exe) + SoftDrv + NullDrv, the last two CPU-only so it still verifies headless under wine+Xvfb. Builds in build-windows/.

configurePresets.name: windows64
configurePresets.description: The 64-bit twin of windows: x86_64-w64-mingw32 with the 64-bit SDL2 and OpenAL Soft builds (LLP64: long stays 4 bytes, pointers are 8). The shipped 32-bit .u packages run unchanged, as on native64. Builds in build-windows64/.
